Question Choices: Select. Does the set {(1, 4), (2, 4), (3, 4)} represent a function? ~~Yes | No~~
Hints: No input repeats.|A shared output is fine.
Solution: Group the pairs by input: 1 maps to 4; 2 maps to 4; 3 maps to 4. Every input has one output, so Yes. Sharing an output is allowed.

Question Choices: Select. Does a nonvertical straight line represent y as a function of x? ~~Yes | No~~
Hints: Apply the vertical line test.|Each x meets the line once.
Solution: A nonvertical line has the form y = mx + b. Each x determines exactly one y, so it passes the vertical line test and represents a function: Yes.
